verdicts.decision_note: The client explicitly requires HubSpot report configuration, establishing persistent CRM reporting behavior.
The client narrows the reporting behavior to a basic sales funnel; overwriting reporting_scope and replacing the reporting context leave no stale value keys.
The client defines the funnel's implemented data and display rules: Contact Source grouping, per-stage counts, and contact-to-lead conversion visibility.
The reported HubSpot Pro dependency materially leaves the implementation approach for the requested custom funnel unresolved.
The client accepts default HubSpot reports as temporarily sufficient, deferring the requested custom Contact Source funnel rather than removing it.
